eps.d: Garden Pea announces the annual Vegetable Show which all the Poddington Peas enter.
Disguised as pirates, Creep-Pea and Black-Eyed Pea bombard Poddington with custard pies, fired from a cannon on board their boat on Poddle Pond.
Dump-Pea overeats at Tea-Pea's cafe and is unable to get through the door.
A small mole causes havoc by uprooting the houses. The Peas help him and themselves by making him a pair of glasses using scrap from Scrap-Pea's yard.
Poddington's Pea-pie are playing at Poddington Hall tonight. The band make their way to the Hall and amusing things happen when they arrive...
High above Poddington, a small bird's egg falls from its nest. The Peas, using their ingenuity, save the egg and protect it until it hatches.

Sweet-Pea and Hap-Pea go to the Chip-Peas for old Pop-Pea's tea. On the way they stop to listen to Hap-Pea singing. It becomes dark and the two Peas don't know what to do. Zip-Pea arrives and, using his speed, solves their problem.
Bump-Pea and Hap-Pea land their hot-air balloon on Creepy Castle, where they are taken prisoner.
Creep-Pea and Black Eyed-Pea go to a cave on Poddle Island and make scary noises loud enough for everyone to hear. Worried it might be a monster Snoop-Pea and P.C Pod decide to investigate.
Dough-Pea the silly baker gets lost on his round.
Zip-Pea's shadow is fed up with having to go fast all the time, so he goes missing. Poor Zip-Pea zooms all over Poddington to find him.
Soap-Pea and Hap-Pea row to Poddle Island where they get stranded. With the help of Soap-Pea's magic bubbles, they solve their problem and learn a lesson.
Creep-Pea and Black-Eyed Pea have a Christmas surprise for the Peas.
